newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMH sees good year in 1997 - Hayek.
newsitem.headline: SMH sees good year in 1997 - Hayek.

text.p: Swiss watchmaker Ste Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA (SMH) expects to post a good year in 1997, chairman Nicholas Hayek said on Tuesday.
"We expect 1997 to be a good year provided we do not have any problems with currencies," he told Reuters in an interview. He did not give any more details.
SMH said it had posted the best January group sales in the company's history this year. A similar situation was expected for February, it added in a statement on 1996 results.
SMH group net rose to a preliminary 282 million Swiss francs in 1996 from 273 million in 1995.
